mode.title: Filtering mode
mode.description: "allowlist" blocks every site except the allowed ones. "blocklist" allows every site except the blocked ones.

allow.title: Allowed sites
allow.description: Domains (example.com, includes subdomains) or domain + path prefixes (example.com/docs).

block.title: Blocked sites
block.description: Domains or domain + path prefixes. Allowed sites win over blocked sites.

approvedSources.title: Approved sources
approvedSources.description: Any link opened from these sites is allowed, whatever its domain.

approvedSourceScope.title: Approved source scope
approvedSourceScope.description: "site" keeps the whole destination site open in that tab. "link" allows only the page that was opened.

protectEssentials.title: Never block essential Google sign-in pages

timezone.title: Time zone for schedules
timezone.description: IANA name such as America/Denver. Empty uses the device clock.

blockMessage.title: Message shown on the blocked page
